method.blob_equality: git blob SHA-1 of each source in a verification input compared with the blob SHA-1 the GitHub trees API reports for the same path at each commit; lib/ paths live in submodules and are compared through the submodule pins instead
method.solc_reproduction: solc --standard-json over the recorded standard-input.json with outputSelection widened to evm.bytecode.object and evm.deployedBytecode.object; creation and deployed bytecode compared byte for byte with the recorded output.json
method.stored_init_code: cast code at the observed block; a stored init code begins with one 0x00 byte and the rest is compared with the recorded creation bytecode; keccak256 of the rest is compared with the factory's marketInitCodeHash() where applicable
method.runtime_modulo_immutables: on-chain runtime code compared with the recorded deployedBytecode; every differing byte must lie inside an immutableReferences range
